title: Survival Retro Life
description: To live Minecraft in a recent version but to have the life of the past would surely be a dream... Well here it is! Live your Retro Life (Use the Built-in ProgrammerArt resourcepack)
body:
# Survival; The Retro Life
Survival: Retro Life is a vanilla+ modpack for Minecraft 1.14.4 Forge, and this pack is designed to give the feel of classic Minecraft into a more modern (but still old) framework, bridging the gap between nostalgia and slightly modern, Mostly nostalgia tho

## Essential Setup Instructions
Resource Pack: For the intended experience, you should enable the built-in Programmer Art resource pack in the Minecraft settings menu.
- Performance: 6GB of allocated RAM is recommended for optimal stability.

## Key Features
Legacy Aesthetic: Restores the Legacy Console Edition background, panorama, and classic UI click sounds.
Classic Mechanics: Re-adds the original Ender Dragon battle mechanics and the classic Enchanted Golden Apple crafting recipe.
World Expansion: Features Biomes O' Plenty and The Endergetic Expansion, curated to feel like natural extensions of the classic world.
Modern Quality of Life: Includes Immersive Portals, dedicated Elytra slots, and Joy of Painting for a more immersive survival experience.
